dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave (falcate) trailing edge exhibiting a significant negative-slope spline curvature from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius; not sharply acute.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree upward incline relative to the horizontal plane of the base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Measured approximately at a 1.7:1 ratio of maximum longitudinal base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical linear depigmentation scar near the basal midline; several minor irregular nicks/serrations visible on the distal trailing edge just below the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white punctate speckling and light mottling distributed across the primary dark grey pigment of the fin.
